name: Straight Bar Dip
how_to:
Setup

1. Find a Sturdy Bar
  - Use a pull-up bar or any horizontal bar at chest height.
2. Grip the Bar
  - Grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Lift Yourself Up
  - Jump or push up so your arms are fully extended and your body is above the bar.
Execution

1. Lower Your Body
  - Lean slightly forward, bending your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar.
  - Keep your elbows close to your sides to target the triceps and chest.
2. Stop at the Bottom
  - Lower until your shoulders are below your elbows or as far as your mobility allows without discomfort.
3. Push Back Up
  - Extend your arms to return to the starting position, keeping your core tight for balance.
4. Repeat
  - Perform 8–12 repetitions for 2–3 sets, depending on your strength level.
